home.participantsHeadline: Built for agricultural producers and industrial feedstock buyers.
home.participantsDesc: CropCycle Connect provides dedicated portals tailored to the operational requirements of agricultural cooperatives and industrial processing facilities.
home.farmerPortalDesc: Monetize harvest residue without burning. List surplus paddy, wheat, or sugarcane straw and connect directly with verified industrial purchasers.
home.farmerFeat1Desc: Log crop species, volume in tonnes, and harvest availability window.
home.farmerFeat2Desc: Immediately receive ranked buyers based on geographic proximity and required lot sizes.
home.farmerFeat3Desc: Choose on-farm collection or cooperative depot delivery.
home.buyerPortalDesc: Secure consistent biomass raw material supplies. Define specifications, manage yard intake schedules, and aggregate nearby farm lots.
home.buyerFeat1Desc: Specify accepted residue species, required batch tonnages, and maximum intake caps.
home.buyerFeat2Desc: Automatically group multiple smallholder farms within 25 km into single freight deliveries.
home.buyerFeat3Desc: Review turnkey route miles, estimated transit hours, and pickup coordination.
home.stage1Desc: Farmers and FPOs record available lot volumes, residue species, field coordinates, and harvest windows.
home.stage2Desc: Our deterministic algorithm evaluates quantity fit (40%), distance (30%), intake capacity (20%), and use-case synergy (10%).
home.stage3Desc: Smallholder volumes within a 15 km radius are grouped into full freight batches to minimize transport overhead.
home.stage4Desc: Residue is routed to bio-CNG plants, paper mills, and animal feed units — eliminating open burning permanently.
home.feedstockDesc: Standardized feedstock catalog mapped to industrial processing thresholds and energetic outputs.
home.impactHeadline: Redirecting 1 tonne of paddy straw prevents ~91 kg of greenhouse emissions.
home.impactDesc: Open-field residue burning disperses significant particulate matter (PM2.5, PM10), carbon monoxide, and volatile organic compounds across northern agricultural belts. By shifting agricultural biomass into industrial bioenergy and circular manufacturing, CropCycle Connect eliminates field emissions while preserving topsoil microbial vitality.
home.joinDesc: Whether you manage agricultural acreage or oversee industrial biomass intake, begin evaluating verified matches today.
